testcase.name: native status reflects a physical connection and a missing device
Tauri events reach the active recorder and retain device timestamps
native save completion survives menu rendering and write failures remain retryable
missing or non-finite coordinates cannot become valid gaze at zero
gaze statistics update even outside an assessment
a stream failure updates status and interrupts a trial listener
the injected bridge client binds its events once
every module reads and retains the entered hit threshold through saving and scoring
threshold controls share a calibrated range and reject invalid settings
saccade span sliders use calibrated screen dimensions, distance and target clearance
saccade spans change displayed coordinates using physical calibration, independently of scoring
saccade bounds include target radius and reject spans that no longer fit after recalibration
tobii pursuit excludes the cross and keeps a visible target through the return to center
tobii fixation scores only edge hold and clips sample intervals at its onset
tobii TFF uses source time, detects an off-target fixation and ignores the accuracy grace window
webgazer pursuit excludes the cross and keeps a visible target through the return to center
webgazer fixation scores only edge hold and clips sample intervals at its onset
webgazer TFF uses source time, detects an off-target fixation and ignores the accuracy grace window
TFF does not count the fixation carried over from the previous target
TFF requires 100 ms of uninterrupted valid fixation and does not interpolate blinks or gaps
TFF is independent of sample rate and resets detection for every target
TFF retains a separate N/A outcome for targets without valid samples
native samples drive scoring and CSV export, with blinks excluded
no samples, all invalid samples and untracked sessions report N/A
zero-data validation blocks proceeding and does not invent an error threshold
native clock synchronization measures clock origins using the lowest round trip
screen gaze is translated through window borders and DPI scaling
effective 1.5 degree threshold is a radius and converts each physical axis separately
